papers.title: Major cardiovascular event risk of advanced therapies in inflammatory bowel diseases: systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.journal_full: Inflammation research : official journal of the European Histamine Research Society ... [et al.]
papers.authors: Alnahdi A, Salmon C, Du F, Svensson M, Chaudhry N, Zimmermann E
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Patients with chronic immune-mediated disorders (IMIDs), including inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), are at increased risk of cardiovascular disease. While advanced therapies show cardioprotective effects in other IMIDs, their impact on major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) in IBD remains unclear. We conducted a meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and observational studies evaluating MACE risk with advanced therapies in IBD.
METHODS: Systematic search of PubMed, Embase, and Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials identified 43 studies (36 RCTs, including 9 long-term follow-up (LTF) studies, and 7 observational studies) published between 2002 and 2024. Primary analyses estimated odds ratios (OR) for MACE comparing advanced therapy to placebo, with secondary analyses stratifying studies by drug class and length of follow-up. Sensitivity analyses were conducted using alternative methods to account for zero-event data.
RESULTS: Placebo-controlled RCTs showed a nonsignificant trend toward reduced MACE risk (OR 0.60; 95% CI 0.24-1.51), with similar findings across sensitivity analyses accounting for sparse and zero-event data. Class-specific trends suggested lower MACE risk with IL-12/IL-23 inhibitors (OR 0.35; 95% CI 0.05-2.21), JAK inhibitors (OR 0.57; 95% CI 0.16-2.06), and a potential increase with Anti-TNF agents (OR: 3.04; 95% CI 0.31-29.47), though none reached statistical significance. LTF studies showed consistent findings. Observational studies suggested lower MACE risk with Anti-TNF therapies (OR 0.29; 95% CI 0.21-0.40), but not with IL-12/IL-23 (OR 4.41; 95% CI 0.49-39.28) or JAK inhibitors (OR 1.57; 95% CI 0.86-2.84).
CONCLUSION: Advanced therapies did not demonstrate a clear increase or decrease in cardiovascular risk in IBD. The discrepancies between RCTs and observational studies underscore the urgent need for rigorous-designed observational research with long-term follow-up to evaluate the real-world impact of advanced therapies on MACE risk.

papers.title_zh: 發炎性腸道疾病中先進治療藥物之主要心血管事件風險：系統性回顧與統合分析
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：慢性免疫介導疾病（IMIDs）患者，包括發炎性腸道疾病（IBD），心血管疾病風險增加。雖然先進治療藥物在其他IMIDs中顯示心臟保護效果，但其對IBD患者主要不良心血管事件（MACE）的影響仍不明確。我們針對評估IBD先進治療與MACE風險之隨機對照試驗（RCT）與觀察性研究進行統合分析。方法：系統性檢索PubMed、Embase及Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials，找出2002至2024年間發表的43篇研究（36篇RCT，包含9篇長期追蹤研究，以及7篇觀察性研究）。主要分析估算先進治療相較於安慰劑之MACE勝算比（OR），次要分析依藥物類別及追蹤時間分層。並使用替代方法進行敏感性分析以處理零事件資料。結果：安慰劑對照RCT顯示MACE風險降低之非顯著趨勢（OR 0.60；95% CI 0.24-1.51），在處理稀疏及零事件資料的敏感性分析中結果相似。藥物類別特異性趨勢顯示IL-12/IL-23抑制劑（OR 0.35；95% CI 0.05-2.21）及JAK抑制劑（OR 0.57；95% CI 0.16-2.06）之MACE風險較低，而Anti-TNF藥物則可能增加風險（OR 3.04；95% CI 0.31-29.47），但均未達統計顯著性。長期追蹤研究結果一致。觀察性研究顯示Anti-TNF治療之MACE風險較低（OR 0.29；95% CI 0.21-0.40），但IL-12/IL-23抑制劑（OR 4.41；95% CI 0.49-39.28）或JAK抑制劑（OR 1.57；95% CI 0.86-2.84）則無此發現。結論：先進治療藥物在IBD中並未顯示明確的心血管風險增加或降低。RCT與觀察性研究之間的差異凸顯出迫切需要設計嚴謹、長期追蹤的觀察性研究，以評估先進治療藥物對MACE風險的真實世界影響。

papers.title: A therapeutic atlas of monogenic inflammatory bowel disease
papers.authors: Yeh P, Charlesworth J, Taylor H, Ashton J, Nash K, Lam K
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Evidence-based, mechanism-guided therapies are urgently needed for treating monogenic inflammatory bowel disease (mIBD). For such rare diseases, mechanistic insight is essential to guide treatment when conventional clinical trials are often not feasible. We aimed to summarize literature-based evidence and to identify knowledge gaps.
METHODS: We conducted a systematic review of published manuscripts evaluating the therapeutic efficacy in mIBD. We quantified and compared the global therapeutic response score across treatments and conditions. In a subset of conditions, biomarkers of longitudinal therapeutic response were evaluated in comparison to non-monogenic pediatric IBD cohorts.
RESULTS: Responses to 35 therapeutics across the 102 known genetic causes of mIBD were evaluated in 241 articles and 669 patients, summarizing 302 gene-drug responses. The efficacy of at least one pharmacological intervention was identified in 61% (n = 62/102) of the mIBD conditions, highlighting a major unmet need for effective medications in many others. Gene- and pathway-specific responses were demonstrated for several therapies, including allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation, gene therapy, and advanced therapies such as anti-TNF agents, IL-1 inhibitors, mTOR inhibitors, as well as eculizumab in CD55 deficiency, abatacept in CTLA4 deficiency, and the immunometabolic agent empagliflozin in glycogen storage disease type 1b.
CONCLUSIONS: This study highlights the potential of precision medicine approaches tailored to genetic and pathway-specific mechanisms, while underscoring the urgent need for effective therapies in many monogenic conditions that remain without established treatment options.
papers.title_zh: 單基因型發炎性腸道疾病的治療圖譜
papers.abstract_zh: 背景與目的：單基因型發炎性腸道疾病（mIBD）迫切需要以實證為基礎、機制導向的治療。對於此類罕見疾病，由於傳統臨床試驗常不可行，機制上的理解對於指導治療至關重要。我們旨在總結文獻證據並找出知識缺口。方法：我們進行了一項系統性回顧，評估mIBD的治療效果相關文獻。我們量化並比較不同治療與疾病之間的整體治療反應評分。在部分疾病亞群中，我們評估了縱向治療反應的生物標記，並與非單基因型小兒IBD世代進行比較。結果：我們在241篇文獻、669名患者中，評估了102種已知mIBD遺傳病因對35種治療藥物的反應，總結出302組基因-藥物反應關係。在61%（62/102）的mIBD疾病中，至少發現一種藥物治療具有療效，突顯出許多其他疾病仍存在有效藥物的重大未滿足需求。多項治療顯示出基因與路徑特異性的反應，包括異體造血幹細胞移植、基因治療，以及進階治療如抗TNF製劑、IL-1抑制劑、mTOR抑制劑，還有eculizumab用於CD55缺乏症、abatacept用於CTLA4缺乏症，以及免疫代謝藥物empagliflozin用於第1b型糖原儲積症。結論：本研究強調針對基因與路徑特異性機制之精準醫療方法的潛力，同時也凸顯許多單基因型疾病仍缺乏既定治療選項的迫切需求。

papers.title: Modified Albert-Lembert coloanal anastomosis with diverting ileostomy versus Turnbull-Cutait pull-through delayed coloanal anastomosis after intersphincteric resection for low rectal cancer: a single-center retrospective comparative study
papers.authors: Li M, Liang H, Wang X, Yang Z, Yang L, Lian G
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Reconstruction after intersphincteric resection (ISR) for low rectal cancer remains technically challenging. Turnbull-Cutait pull-through delayed coloanal anastomosis (DCAA) has been used as a sphincter-preserving delayed reconstructive strategy, but it requires exteriorization of the colon and a planned second-stage perineal procedure. To improve anastomotic stability after ISR, we performed modified Albert-Lembert coloanal anastomosis (MALA) with diverting ileostomy. This study aimed to compare the short-term clinical outcomes of MALA with diverting ileostomy versus DCAA after ISR for low rectal cancer.
METHODS: This single-center retrospective comparative study was conducted at Henan Provincial People's Hospital. Between February 2023 and October 2025, consecutive patients with low rectal cancer who underwent laparoscopic ISR followed by hand-sewn coloanal anastomosis were reviewed. Among them, 58 patients underwent Turnbull-Cutait pull-through delayed coloanal anastomosis (DCAA group), and 42 patients underwent modified Albert-Lembert one-stage coloanal anastomosis with diverting ileostomy (MALA group). Clinical outcomes were compared between the two groups. The primary outcome was overall postoperative morbidity within 30 days after the first surgery.
RESULTS: A total of 100 patients were included, with 58 in the DCAA group and 42 in the MALA group. Baseline demographic, clinical, and tumor characteristics were comparable between the two groups. The 30-day overall postoperative morbidity rates were 32.8% and 23.8% in the DCAA and MALA groups, respectively, with no statistically significant between-group difference (P = 0.378). No statistically significant differences were observed in the rates of Clavien-Dindo grade I-II complications (19.0% vs. 16.7%, P = 0.799) or grade III or higher complications (13.8% vs. 7.1%, P = 0.350). Operative time (201.8 ± 28.6 min vs. 206.5 ± 32.4 min, P = 0.463), intraoperative blood loss [60 mL (range, 30-150) vs. 60 mL (range, 30-110), P = 0.408], harvested lymph nodes [19 (range, 15-23) vs. 22 (range, 16-24), P = 0.356], R0 resection rate (100% vs. 100%, P = 1.000), and postoperative hospital stay [15 days (range, 13-21) vs. 14 days (range, 12-20), P = 0.225] did not differ significantly between the two groups.
CONCLUSIONS: MALA with diverting ileostomy is a technically feasible sphincter-preserving reconstructive strategy in selected patients undergoing laparoscopic ISR for low rectal cancer, and no statistically significant difference in 30-day postoperative morbidity was observed between the MALA and DCAA groups.

papers.title_zh: 低位直腸癌括約肌間切除術（ISR）後：改良Albert-Lembert結腸肛管吻合合併預防性回腸造口 vs Turnbull-Cutait拖出式延遲結腸肛管吻合（DCAA）之單中心回溯性比較研究
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：低位直腸癌括約肌間切除術（ISR）後的重建仍具技術挑戰性。Turnbull-Cutait拖出式延遲結腸肛管吻合（DCAA）已被用作保留括約肌的延遲重建策略，但需將結腸外置並計畫第二階段會陰手術。為改善ISR後吻合口穩定性，我們採用改良Albert-Lembert結腸肛管吻合（MALA）合併預防性回腸造口。本研究旨在比較ISR後MALA合併預防性回腸造口與DCAA之短期臨床結果。
方法：本單中心回溯性比較研究於河南省人民醫院進行。2023年2月至2025年10月間，連續接受腹腔鏡ISR併手縫結腸肛管吻合之低位直腸癌病人納入審查。其中58名病人接受Turnbull-Cutait拖出式延遲結腸肛管吻合（DCAA組），42名病人接受改良Albert-Lembert一期結腸肛管吻合合併預防性回腸造口（MALA組）。比較兩組之臨床結果。主要結果為首次手術後30天內總體術後併發症發生率。
結果：共納入100名病人，DCAA組58名，MALA組42名。兩組基本人口學、臨床及腫瘤特徵相當。DCAA組與MALA組之30天總體術後併發症發生率分別為32.8%與23.8%，兩組間無統計顯著差異（P=0.378）。Clavien-Dindo I-II級併發症（19.0% vs. 16.7%，P=0.799）或III級以上併發症（13.8% vs. 7.1%，P=0.350）發生率亦無顯著差異。手術時間（201.8 ± 28.6分鐘 vs. 206.5 ± 32.4分鐘，P=0.463）、術中出血量[60毫升（範圍30-150）vs. 60毫升（範圍30-110），P=0.408]、取出淋巴結數[19（範圍15-23）vs. 22（範圍16-24），P=0.356]、R0切除率（100% vs. 100%，P=1.000）、術後住院天數[15天（範圍13-21）vs. 14天（範圍12-20），P=0.225]兩組間亦無顯著差異。
結論：MALA合併預防性回腸造口是接受腹腔鏡ISR治療低位直腸癌之特定病人中，技術上可行的保留括約肌重建策略，且MALA組與DCAA組之30天術後併發症無統計顯著差異。

papers.title: Epigenetic plus cytokine therapy induces stem-like CD8+ T-cell reservoirs and intratumoral immune niches to overcome anti-PD-1 resistance
papers.authors: Minnar C, Miyamoto M, Khelifa A, Lui G, Lothstein K, Meler A
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Checkpoint blockade (CPB) has limited efficacy in patients with colorectal cancer (CRC), warranting improved therapeutic strategies capable of remodeling the tumor microenvironment. Stem-like TCF1+CD8+ T cells, cytotoxic CD8+ T cells, and lymphoid aggregates have been associated with CPB responsiveness, either individually or as coordinated immune hubs.
METHODS: We evaluated the combination of αPD-1, the class I histone deacetylase inhibitor entinostat, and the IL-15 superagonist N-803 in CPB-resistant murine CRC and breast cancer models with varying antigen presentation deficiencies. Proteomic, transcriptomic, spatial, and functional analyses were completed to identify treatment-specific immune remodeling. Translational relevance was assessed using publicly available CPB-treated cancer genomic datasets and functional assays with patient-derived peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs).
RESULTS: Triple therapy increased stem-like TCF1+CD8+ T cells in tumor-draining lymph nodes and tumors, concomitant with increased intratumoral cytotoxic GZMB+CD8+ T cells. Therapeutic efficacy was associated with remodeling of the tumor microenvironment, uniquely marked by enrichment of intratumoral immune niches comprising TCF1+ and cytotoxic CD8+ T cells, type 1 conventional dendritic cells, and B cells, along with concerted cytokine and chemokine production. A transcriptional signature derived from triple therapy-induced immune niches predicted favorable clinical responses across multiple CPB-experienced cancer cohorts. These responses were functionally corroborated by increased markers of cytotoxicity in patient-derived PBMCs in vitro.
CONCLUSIONS: Treatment with entinostat, N-803, and αPD-1 boosts anti-tumor intratumoral immune niches comprising TCF1+CD8+ T cells. Collectively, these findings suggest that TCF1+CD8+ T cell immune niches previously associated with αPD-1 responsiveness and lacking in non-responders, including most CRC patients, may be restored by the addition of entinostat and N-803 to αPD-1 therapy to treat αPD-1-refractory patients.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景：免疫檢查點阻斷（CPB）療法在大腸直腸癌（CRC）病人中療效有限，需要能夠重塑腫瘤微環境的改良治療策略。幹細胞樣TCF1+CD8+ T細胞、細胞毒殺性CD8+ T細胞，以及淋巴聚集體，無論單獨或作為協調的免疫樞紐，皆與CPB治療反應相關。方法：研究團隊在具有不同抗原呈現缺陷的CPB抗藥性小鼠大腸直腸癌與乳癌模型中，評估αPD-1、第一類組蛋白去乙醯酶抑制劑entinostat，以及IL-15超級促效劑N-803三者合併治療的效果。完成蛋白質體學、轉錄體學、空間分析及功能性分析，以鑑定治療特異性的免疫重塑。並利用公開可得的CPB治療癌症基因體資料集，以及病人周邊血單核球細胞（PBMC）功能性檢測，評估其轉譯應用價值。結果：三合一療法增加了腫瘤引流淋巴結及腫瘤內幹細胞樣TCF1+CD8+ T細胞，並伴隨腫瘤內GZMB+CD8+細胞毒殺性T細胞增加。治療效果與腫瘤微環境重塑有關，其特徵為腫瘤內免疫微環境（niche）的富集，此微環境包含TCF1+與細胞毒殺性CD8+ T細胞、第一型傳統樹突細胞及B細胞，並伴隨協調的細胞激素與趨化激素分泌。由三合一療法誘導之免疫微環境所衍生的轉錄特徵，能在多個CPB治療經驗的癌症世代中預測良好的臨床反應。這些反應也在病人來源PBMC的體外實驗中，以細胞毒性標記增加獲得功能性驗證。結論：以entinostat、N-803及αPD-1治療可增強含TCF1+CD8+ T細胞的抗腫瘤腫瘤內免疫微環境。整體而言，這些發現顯示先前與αPD-1治療反應相關、但在非反應者（包括大多數CRC病人）中缺乏的TCF1+CD8+ T細胞免疫微環境，或可透過在αPD-1療法中加入entinostat與N-803而恢復，用以治療αPD-1難治型病人。

papers.title: CEA-targeted CAR-NK cells derived from embryonic stem cells exhibit potent anti-tumor activity against colorectal cancer
papers.authors: Li G, Zhao L, Shen J, Wang H, He J, Liu Y
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Carcinoembryonic antigen (CEA) is overexpressed in most colorectal cancers (CRC) and serves as a promising immunotherapeutic target. However, current immune cell therapies against CRC show limited clinical efficacy, and the lack of renewable, standardized cell sources hampers broader application. The present study aimed to establish a scalable source of CEA-targeted natural killer (NK) cells from engineered human embryonic stem cells (hESCs).
METHODS: hESCs were genetically engineered to express a CEA‑specific chimeric antigen receptor (CAR). The modified hESCs were subsequently differentiated into NK cells, yielding a homogeneous population of CAR hESC-NK cells. In vitro cytotoxicity against CEA-high CRC cell lines was evaluated using LDH and IFN-γ release assays. For in vivo assessment, we established a xenograft mouse model bearing CEA-positive CRC tumors. Following adoptive transfer of CAR-hESC-NK cells, tumor growth was monitored by bioluminescence imaging, overall survival was recorded for Kaplan-Meier analysis, and the persistence of transferred cells in peripheral blood was examined by flow cytometric analysis at serial time points.
RESULTS: In vitro, CAR hESC‑NK cells demonstrated potent and specific cytotoxicity against CEA-high CRC cell lines, along with significantly enhanced cytokine secretion compared to unmodified NK cells. In the xenograft model, adoptive transfer of CAR hESC‑NK cells resulted in marked tumor growth inhibition and prolonged survival, with no observable off‑target toxicity. Importantly, the CAR CEA‑ESC line maintained stable transgene expression and could serve as a renewable seed cell source.
CONCLUSION: We have established a scalable platform for producing CEA‑targeted NK cells from engineered hESCs, providing an off‑the‑shelf, homogeneous cell product with robust antitumor activity. This strategy provides effective and specific immunotherapy against CEA-positive colorectal cancer and holds potential for other CEA-expressing malignancies.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景：癌胚抗原（CEA）在多數大腸直腸癌（CRC）中過度表現，是極具潛力的免疫治療標靶。然而目前針對CRC的免疫細胞療法臨床療效有限，且缺乏可再生、標準化的細胞來源，限制其廣泛應用。本研究旨在建立一種源自基因工程化人類胚胎幹細胞（hESCs）、可規模化生產的CEA標靶自然殺手（NK）細胞來源。方法：以基因工程改造hESCs使其表現CEA專一性嵌合抗原受體（CAR），將改造後的hESCs分化為NK細胞，產生均質的CAR hESC-NK細胞族群。以LDH及IFN-γ釋放試驗評估其對CEA高表現CRC細胞株的體外細胞毒殺活性。體內評估則建立帶有CEA陽性CRC腫瘤的異種移植小鼠模型，於過繼輸注CAR-hESC-NK細胞後以生物冷光影像監測腫瘤生長、記錄整體存活以進行Kaplan-Meier分析，並於多個時間點以流式細胞術檢測輸注細胞於周邊血中的持續性。結果：體外實驗顯示，CAR hESC-NK細胞對CEA高表現CRC細胞株具強效且專一性的細胞毒殺作用，其細胞激素分泌亦顯著高於未修飾NK細胞。於異種移植模型中，過繼輸注CAR hESC-NK細胞可顯著抑制腫瘤生長並延長存活，且未觀察到脫靶毒性。此外，CAR CEA-ESC細胞株維持穩定的轉殖基因表現，可作為可再生的種子細胞來源。結論：本研究建立了一個可規模化生產CEA標靶NK細胞的平台，源自工程化hESCs，提供一種現貨型（off-the-shelf）、均質的細胞產品，具強健的抗腫瘤活性。此策略對CEA陽性大腸直腸癌及其他表現CEA的惡性腫瘤，提供了有效且專一性的免疫治療潛力。

papers.title: Integrated multi-omics, network pharmacology, and experimental validation reveal the protective mechanisms of curcumol against DSS-induced ulcerative colitis
papers.authors: Shu F, Chen K, Song Y, Li J, Shen M, Guo Z
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Ulcerative colitis (UC) is a chronic relapsing inflammatory bowel disease characterized by mucosal immune imbalance, epithelial barrier disruption, and intestinal dysbiosis. Curcumol (CUR) possesses anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory activities; however, the multilevel mechanisms underlying its protective effects against dextran sulfate sodium (DSS)-induced UC remain incompletely understood.
METHODS: A mouse model of UC was established in C57BL/6J mice using 3% DSS. CUR or 5-aminosalicylic acid (5-ASA) was administered once daily beginning on the first day of DSS exposure, with 5-ASA serving as a phenotypic positive control. The protective effects of CUR were evaluated based on body weight change, disease activity index (DAI), colon length, histopathological alterations, inflammatory cytokine levels, and barrier-related molecules. Based on the pharmacodynamic and phenotypic evaluation, the high-dose CUR group was selected for subsequent mechanistic studies, including fecal 16S rRNA gene sequencing, fecal untargeted metabolomics, colonic transcriptome sequencing, analysis of public human UC transcriptomic datasets, and integrative network pharmacology, followed by experimental validation of key candidate molecules.
RESULTS: CUR significantly ameliorated DSS-induced body weight loss, reduced DAI scores, preserved colon length, and alleviated histopathological injury. CUR also decreased the levels of TNF-α, IL-1β, IL-6, and IL-17, restored goblet cell abundance, and partially restored the protein expression of MUC2, claudin-1, ZO-1, and occludin. Moreover, these protective effects were generally more pronounced in the high-dose CUR group, with significant between-dose differences observed for selected endpoints (P < 0.05). Further exploratory analyses showed that high-dose CUR partially restored gut microbial diversity and reshaped community structure while partially reversing DSS-induced metabolic disturbances. Integrative analysis of mouse colonic transcriptomics, public human UC transcriptomic datasets, and network pharmacology converged on SPP1 and CD44 as candidate hub genes and implicated the PI3K/Akt signaling pathway as a key candidate pathway altered by DSS exposure and modulated by CUR. Experimental validation further demonstrated that high-dose CUR reduced the expression of SPP1, CD44, and PIK3CB and decreased the p-p85/p85 and p-Akt/Akt ratios. Multiplex immunofluorescence further showed a reduction in the macrophage-associated fraction of SPP1-positive cells after high-dose CUR intervention.
CONCLUSIONS: Concurrent administration of CUR exerted protective effects in a DSS-induced mouse model of UC by reducing inflammation and mucosal barrier injury and partially normalizing gut microbial and fecal metabolic profiles. These effects were associated with attenuation of SPP1/CD44/PI3K/Akt-related signaling, suggesting that this signaling network may contribute to CUR-mediated protection against DSS-induced UC.

papers.abstract_zh:
背景：潰瘍性結腸炎（UC）是一種慢性復發性發炎性腸道疾病，特徵為黏膜免疫失衡、上皮屏障破壞與腸道菌叢失調。薑黃酮（Curcumol, CUR）具有抗發炎與免疫調節活性，然而其對抗右旋糖酐硫酸鈉（DSS）誘導UC的多層次保護機轉仍未完全闡明。
方法：以3% DSS建立C57BL/6J小鼠UC模型。自DSS暴露第一天起每日給予CUR或5-胺基水楊酸（5-ASA，作為表型陽性對照組）。以體重變化、疾病活動指數（DAI）、結腸長度、組織病理學變化、發炎細胞激素濃度及屏障相關分子評估CUR的保護效果。根據藥效與表型評估結果，選定高劑量CUR組進行後續機轉研究，包括糞便16S rRNA基因定序、糞便非標靶代謝體學、結腸轉錄體定序、公開人類UC轉錄體資料庫分析及整合網絡藥理學，並進一步對關鍵候選分子進行實驗驗證。
結果：CUR顯著改善DSS誘導的體重減輕、降低DAI分數、維持結腸長度並減輕組織病理學損傷。CUR亦降低TNF-α、IL-1β、IL-6及IL-17濃度，恢復杯狀細胞數量，並部分恢復MUC2、claudin-1、ZO-1及occludin蛋白表現。這些保護效果在高劑量CUR組通常更為明顯，部分終點觀察到具統計顯著性的劑量間差異（P < 0.05）。進一步探索性分析顯示，高劑量CUR部分恢復腸道菌叢多樣性並重塑菌群結構，同時部分逆轉DSS誘導的代謝紊亂。整合小鼠結腸轉錄體學、公開人類UC轉錄體資料庫及網絡藥理學分析，聚焦於SPP1與CD44作為候選核心基因，並指出PI3K/Akt訊號傳導路徑為DSS暴露改變、且受CUR調節的關鍵候選路徑。實驗驗證進一步證實，高劑量CUR降低SPP1、CD44及PIK3CB表現，並降低p-p85/p85及p-Akt/Akt比值。多重免疫螢光染色進一步顯示，高劑量CUR介入後SPP1陽性細胞中巨噬細胞相關比例下降。
結論：同時給予CUR可透過減少發炎與黏膜屏障損傷、部分正常化腸道菌叢與糞便代謝譜，在DSS誘導UC小鼠模型中發揮保護效果。這些效果與SPP1/CD44/PI3K/Akt相關訊號傳導的減弱有關，顯示此訊號網絡可能參與CUR介導的DSS誘導UC保護作用。

papers.title: Intratumoral Bacillus regulating colorectal cancer liver metastasis: links to lipid metabolism and APOE+ macrophages
papers.authors: Chu J, Huang H, Hu Y, Wang Q, Yuan T, Huang S
papers.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Colorectal cancer liver metastasis (CRLM) develops in a hepatic niche where tumor cells encounter organ‑specific microbial, metabolic, and immune constraints. The role of intratumoral bacteria in this metastatic ecosystem remains incompletely defined.
METHODS: We analyzed tumor and peritumoral tissues from 20 patients with non‑metastatic colorectal cancer (CRC) and 20 patients with CRLM by 5R 16S rDNA sequencing, untargeted metabolomics, and functional assays. Public datasets were used for single‑cell analysis of the tumor immune microenvironment.
RESULTS: Primary colorectal lesions and paired liver metastases showed distinct microbial structures. Liver metastatic lesions had lower microbial diversity, and 73 genera differed between CRLM primary tumors and liver metastases. Bacillus was enriched in metastatic tumors and was associated with fatty‑acid‑related microbial pathways, serum CEA and CA19‑9 levels, and lipid‑related metabolites that accumulated in liver metastases. Bacillus supernatant increased SW480 and SW620 cell migration and proliferation in vitro, with the strongest activity at a multiplicity of infection (MOI)‑equivalent of 20. In an intrasplenic CRLM model, viable Bacillus and Bacillus supernatant increased metastatic tumor growth, whereas antibiotic intervention reduced this effect. Metabolomic profiling detected enrichment of lipids and lipid‑like molecules, including carnitine‑ and bile‑acid‑related metabolites, in liver metastatic lesions. Single‑cell analysis of public datasets showed remodeling of the tumor immune microenvironment (TIME) and identified APOE⁺ macrophages as lipid‑associated myeloid cells with broad ligand‑receptor communication with epithelial, immune, and stromal compartments.
DISCUSSION: Together, these findings provide evidence that Bacillus promotes metastatic phenotypes and reveal associations among intratumoral Bacillus, lipid‑related metabolic alterations, and APOE+ macrophage‑associated communication signatures in CRLM.

papers.abstract_zh:
背景：大腸直腸癌肝轉移（CRLM）發生於具有器官特異性微生物、代謝與免疫限制的肝臟微環境中。腫瘤內細菌在此轉移生態系統中的角色尚未完全釐清。
方法：我們分析20名非轉移性大腸直腸癌（CRC）病患與20名CRLM病患的腫瘤及腫瘤周邊組織，採用5R 16S rDNA定序、非標靶代謝體學及功能性試驗。並利用公開資料庫進行腫瘤免疫微環境的單細胞分析。
結果：原發大腸直腸病灶與配對之肝轉移灶顯示不同的微生物結構。肝轉移病灶的微生物多樣性較低，CRLM原發腫瘤與肝轉移灶間有73個屬有差異。芽孢桿菌屬（Bacillus）在轉移性腫瘤中富集，並與脂肪酸相關微生物路徑、血清CEA與CA19-9濃度，以及在肝轉移中累積的脂質相關代謝物相關。芽孢桿菌上清液在體外增加SW480與SW620細胞的遷移與增殖，在感染複數（MOI）當量為20時活性最強。在脾內注射CRLM模型中，活的芽孢桿菌及其上清液增加轉移性腫瘤生長，而抗生素介入則減少此效應。代謝體學分析檢測到肝轉移病灶中脂質及類脂分子的富集，包括肉鹼與膽酸相關代謝物。公開資料庫的單細胞分析顯示腫瘤免疫微環境（TIME）發生重塑，並鑑定出APOE⁺巨噬細胞為與上皮、免疫及基質區室有廣泛配體-受體通訊的脂質相關骨髓細胞。
討論：這些發現提供證據顯示芽孢桿菌促進轉移表型，並揭示腫瘤內芽孢桿菌、脂質相關代謝改變與APOE+巨噬細胞相關通訊特徵在CRLM中的關聯。

papers.title: Development and validation of a hypoglycemia risk prediction model for hospitalized type 2 diabetes patients following laparoscopic colorectal cancer resection: a retrospective cohort study
papers.authors: Zhuo Y, Zheng Y, Xu J, Li X, Huang W, Ji L
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To identify factors associated with postoperative hypoglycemia among inpatients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) receiving laparoscopic colorectal cancer (CRC) resection, and to construct a predictive model for assessing hypoglycemia risk.
METHODS: This retrospective cohort study collected data on hospitalized T2DM patients who underwent laparoscopic CRC resection between January 2021 and June 2023, and randomized them into a training and an internal validation cohorts in a 7:3 ratio. Multivariate logistic regression was used to build a prediction model for in-hospital hypoglycemia after laparoscopic CRC resection and identify independent predictors for level 1 and level 2 hypoglycemia.
RESULTS: Among 720 hospitalized T2DM patients receiving laparoscopic CRC resection, the overall incidence of postoperative hypoglycemia was 16.7% (120 patients), including 98 level 1 cases and 22 level 2 cases. A multivariable predictive model was developed using five independent predictors: long T2DM duration, low preoperative day-1 fasting plasma glucose (FPG), American Society of Anes- thesiologists physical status grade > II, prolonged postoperative fasting, and prior long-term insulin therapy. The model yielded an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.817 (95% confidence interval [CI], 0.774-0.859) in the training cohort and 0.751 (95% CI, 0.669-0.833) in the validation cohort for hypoglycemia prediction. Level 1 postoperative hypoglycemia was independently predicted by long T2DM duration, low preoperative day-1 FPG, and prolonged postoperative fasting; while level 2 hypoglycemia was associated with low body mass index (BMI), low pre- operative day-1 FPG, and elevated neutrophil (NEUT) proportion on postoperative day 3.
CONCLUSIONS: The nomogram prediction model constructed in this study provided reliable risk estimation for postoperative hypoglycemia in hospitalized patients with T2DM undergoing laparoscopic CRC resection, and might serve as a practical adjunct to inform individualized clinical decisions and optimize perioperative glycemic management.

papers.abstract_zh: 目的：探討接受腹腔鏡大腸直腸癌(CRC)切除術之第二型糖尿病(T2DM)住院病人術後發生低血糖之相關因子，並建立低血糖風險評估之預測模型。方法：本回溯性世代研究收集2021年1月至2023年6月間接受腹腔鏡CRC切除術之T2DM住院病人資料，以7:3比例隨機分為訓練世代與內部驗證世代。以多變量邏輯迴歸建立腹腔鏡CRC術後院內低血糖之預測模型，並找出第1級與第2級低血糖之獨立預測因子。結果：共720名接受腹腔鏡CRC切除術之T2DM住院病人，術後低血糖總發生率為16.7%（120名），其中第1級98例、第2級22例。多變量預測模型納入五項獨立預測因子：糖尿病病程長、術前第一天空腹血糖(FPG)偏低、美國麻醉醫學會(ASA)身體狀態分級>II級、術後禁食時間延長，以及先前長期胰島素治療。此模型於訓練世代的接受者操作特徵曲線下面積(AUC)為0.817（95%信賴區間[CI] 0.774-0.859），於驗證世代為0.751（95% CI 0.669-0.833）。第1級術後低血糖之獨立預測因子為糖尿病病程長、術前第一天FPG偏低、術後禁食時間延長；第2級低血糖則與低體重指數(BMI)、術前第一天FPG偏低，以及術後第三天嗜中性球(NEUT)比例升高有關。結論：本研究建立之列線圖(nomogram)預測模型可對接受腹腔鏡CRC切除術之T2DM住院病人術後低血糖風險提供可靠評估，可作為個人化臨床決策與優化圍術期血糖管理之實用輔助工具。

papers.title: Development and internal validation of a prediction model for early anastomotic leak after minimally invasive esophagectomy: a prospective cohort study
papers.authors: Feng Z, Ren X, Xue M, Bao P, Xu H, Gao F
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Anastomotic leak (AL) remains a complication after minimally invasive esophagectomy (MIE), affecting 10-20% of patients and increasing morbidity and mortality. Although local conduit perfusion and systemic nutritional status are central to anastomotic healing, no validated bedside tool integrates quantitative early endoscopic findings with systemic indicators to predict postoperative AL.
METHODS: This prospective single-center cohort study enrolled 583 patients who underwent MIE at Tangdu Hospital. Standardized endoscopy within 72 h quantified gastric conduit ischemic length, and postoperative serum albumin was measured. Multivariable logistic regression and receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis identified independent predictors and optimal cutoffs to develop a risk-stratification system. A Lasso-regularized logistic regression (Lasso LR) model was developed and internally validated (7:3 split), with performance assessed by area under the curve (AUC), calibration curves, and decision curve analysis. Associations with ECCG-defined AL severity were also assessed.
RESULTS: Gastric conduit ischemic length ≥3.5 cm (OR 3.361, p = 0.043) and postoperative serum albumin <31.75 g/L (OR 0.886, p < 0.001) were independent predictors. The Lasso LR model achieved an internal validation AUC of 0.727 (95% CI: 0.641-0.810). The risk-stratification system yielded AL rates of 11.00%, 22.73%, and 73.68% across low-, medium-, and high-risk groups (p < 0.001). Both predictors correlated with ECCG severity. A nomogram and web-based calculators were developed for bedside use.
CONCLUSION: Quantitative gastric conduit ischemic length and postoperative serum albumin enabled individualized AL risk assessment within 72 h after MIE. By integrating local perfusion and systemic healing capacity, the model and digital tools provide a framework for early targeted postoperative management.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景：吻合口漏（AL）仍是微創食道切除術（MIE）後的併發症，發生率10-20%，會增加病殘率與死亡率。雖然局部管道灌流與全身營養狀態對吻合口癒合至關重要，但目前尚無經驗證之床邊工具能整合定量早期內視鏡發現與全身指標來預測術後AL。方法：此前瞻性單中心世代研究納入唐都醫院583名接受MIE病人。術後72小時內以標準化內視鏡定量胃管缺血長度，並測量術後血清白蛋白。以多變量邏輯迴歸與ROC分析找出獨立預測因子與最佳切點，建立風險分層系統。發展並內部驗證（7:3分割）Lasso正則化邏輯迴歸(Lasso LR)模型，以AUC、校正曲線及決策曲線分析評估表現。同時評估與ECCG定義之AL嚴重度的關聯。結果：胃管缺血長度≥3.5公分（OR 3.361，p=0.043）與術後血清白蛋白<31.75 g/L（OR 0.886，p<0.001）為獨立預測因子。Lasso LR模型內部驗證AUC達0.727（95% CI: 0.641-0.810）。風險分層系統下低、中、高風險組之AL發生率分別為11.00%、22.73%、73.68%（p<0.001）。兩項預測因子皆與ECCG嚴重度相關。並發展出列線圖(nomogram)與網頁版計算器供床邊使用。結論：定量胃管缺血長度與術後血清白蛋白可於MIE術後72小時內進行個別化AL風險評估。此模型整合局部灌流與全身癒合能力，為早期針對性術後管理提供框架。試驗註冊：中國臨床試驗註冊中心，ChiCTR2100054550，註冊於2021年12月19日。

papers.title: Research Advances in Nanodrugs Targeting Lipid Metabolism Reprogramming for Colorectal Cancer Therapy
papers.authors: Tang J, Liu M, Zhang R, Li Q, Wang S, Wang Y
papers.abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) remains a major global health burden, with limited efficacy of conventional treatments due to tumor heterogeneity, drug resistance, and systemic toxicity. Lipid metabolism reprogramming has emerged as a hallmark of CRC progression, influencing tumor growth, metastasis, and therapy resistance. Concurrently, nanomedicine offers innovative platforms for targeted drug delivery to to inhibit tumor progression by intervening in the lipid metabolism, including modulation of lipid synthesis, uptake, storage, and cholesterol metabolism. This review provides an integrated perspective, systematically summarizing therapeutic strategies and research progress on nanodrugs targeting lipid metabolic reprogramming in CRC. We highlight nanoplatforms engineered to deliver inhibitors of key enzymes and signaling pathways, such as PI3K/AKT and Wnt/β-catenin. Representative nanoplatforms are discussed to illustrate diverse strategies for regulating lipid metabolic vulnerabilities in CRC, such as carrier-free nanoparticles, RBC membrane-coated nanocages and cholesterol-responsive nanoparticles. We also discuss the challenges in clinical translation, including tumor heterogeneity, biosafety, large-scale production, and clinical validation. Furthermore, we provide insight into translational challenges, emerging trends, and future directions for integrating lipid-targeted nanotherapies into clinical practice.

papers.abstract_zh: 大腸直腸癌（CRC）仍是全球重大健康負擔，傳統治療因腫瘤異質性、抗藥性及全身性毒性而療效有限。脂質代謝重編程已成為CRC進展的標誌之一，影響腫瘤生長、轉移及治療抗性。同時，奈米醫學提供創新的標靶藥物遞送平台，透過介入脂質代謝（包括調控脂質合成、攝取、儲存及膽固醇代謝）來抑制腫瘤進展。本綜述提供整合性觀點，系統性彙整標靶CRC脂質代謝重編程之奈米藥物治療策略與研究進展。我們著重於設計用來遞送關鍵酵素與訊息傳導路徑（如PI3K/AKT及Wnt/β-catenin）抑制劑的奈米平台。文中討論具代表性的奈米平台，以說明調控CRC脂質代謝弱點的多樣策略，例如無載體奈米粒子、紅血球膜包覆奈米籠及膽固醇反應性奈米粒子。我們亦討論臨床轉譯所面臨的挑戰，包括腫瘤異質性、生物安全性、大規模生產及臨床驗證。此外，本文亦提供對於將脂質標靶奈米治療整合入臨床實務之轉譯挑戰、新興趨勢及未來方向的見解。

papers.title: Engineering Small Extracellular Vesicles for Colon-Targeted Delivery: Microenvironment-Responsive Design, Therapeutic Mechanisms, and Clinical Translation
papers.authors: Liu G, Li M, Liu J, Li Y, Huang X, Guo X
papers.abstract: Small extracellular vesicles (sEVs) are endogenous lipid-bilayer nanovesicles that combine cargo protection, biological membrane compatibility, and modifiable surface recognition. For colon-targeted delivery, their value depends on engineering them to withstand gastric acidity and proteolysis, negotiate the mucus barrier, and respond to colon-specific cues, including the distal gastrointestinal pH profile, microbiota-derived enzymes, inflammatory reactive oxygen species, and lesion-associated receptors such as integrins, CD44, and folate receptors. This review critically compares sEVs with conventional colon-targeted drug delivery systems and summarizes sEV biogenesis, cargo sorting, isolation, characterization, exogenous and endogenous loading, surface engineering, and passive, active, and stimuli-responsive targeting strategies. Therapeutic applications are evaluated in inflammatory bowel disease and colorectal cancer, with attention to epithelial barrier restoration, immune regulation, macrophage polarization, apoptosis, tumor-microenvironment remodeling, and emerging intestinal indications such as irritable bowel syndrome. Recent clinical trials, Good Manufacturing Practice requirements, potency and release specifications, safety assessment, and regulatory uncertainties are also discussed. A disease- and route-oriented decision framework is proposed to connect cargo properties, administration route, target-cell biology, manufacturing feasibility, and clinically meaningful endpoints. Although engineered sEVs remain investigational and no therapeutic product has achieved full regulatory approval, integration of microfluidic manufacturing, organ-on-chip validation, artificial intelligence-assisted design, and image-guided precision delivery may improve reproducibility and translational readiness.
papers.title_zh: 工程化小型細胞外囊泡用於大腸靶向遞送：微環境反應性設計、治療機轉與臨床轉譯
papers.abstract_zh: 小型細胞外囊泡（sEVs）是內源性脂雙層奈米囊泡，兼具貨物保護、生物膜相容性及可修飾的表面辨識能力。對於大腸靶向遞送而言，其價值取決於能否經工程改造以耐受胃酸與蛋白酶水解、穿越黏液屏障，並對大腸特有訊號產生反應，包括遠端消化道 pH 值梯度、微生物群衍生酵素、發炎性活性氧物種，以及病灶相關受體如integrin、CD44 與葉酸受體。本綜述批判性地比較 sEVs 與傳統大腸靶向給藥系統，並總結 sEV 的生合成、貨物分選、分離、特性鑑定、外源與內源性載藥、表面工程，以及被動、主動與刺激反應性靶向策略。治療應用方面評估了發炎性腸道疾病與大腸直腸癌，重點包括上皮屏障修復、免疫調節、巨噬細胞極化、細胞凋亡、腫瘤微環境重塑，以及新興腸道適應症如大腸激躁症。文中亦討論近期臨床試驗、優良製造規範（GMP）要求、效力與釋放規格、安全性評估及法規不確定性。本文提出以疾病與給藥途徑為導向的決策框架，以連結貨物特性、給藥途徑、目標細胞生物學、製造可行性及具臨床意義的終點指標。儘管工程化 sEVs 仍屬於研究階段，尚無治療性產品獲得完整法規核准，但微流體製造、器官晶片驗證、人工智慧輔助設計及影像導引精準遞送的整合，可能提升其再現性與轉譯準備度。
